description: Cellular network analysis: srsRAN 4G/5G, LTESniffer, FALCON, LTE Cell Scanner, Osmocom GSM stack, and kalibrate-hackrf.
notes:
Cellular analysis tools for GSM/LTE/5G. srsRAN provides eNodeB and UE simulation. LTESniffer and FALCON for passive LTE analysis. Osmocom for GSM.

For USB SDR device access, the container runs privileged.
